paper_metadata.title: Formation and Mechanical Behavior of Body-Centered-Cubic Zr(Hf)-Nb-Ti Medium-Entropy Alloys

evidence.quote: The present work investigated the formation and mechanical behavior of body-centered-cubic (BCC) Zr(Hf)-Nb-Ti medium entropy alloys (MEAs)
The BCC structural stability and its effect on the mechanical property of Zr(Hf)-Nb-Ti medium entropy alloys (MEAs) were investigated in the present work.
